problems.problem: Bottle appears to float above the tabletop, lacking a natural contact shadow that grounds it to the surface.
The bottle is slightly off-center, creating an unbalanced visual weight that disrupts the intended symmetry.
The dark charcoal plaster wall has inconsistent texture and lacks the clean, restrained gold accents specified in the prompt, appearing overly busy.
The subtitle 'EAU DE PARFUM' is positioned too close to the title 'J'ADORE', reducing hierarchy and readability.

changes.value: An empty studio with a smooth dark charcoal plaster wall and a broad dark stone tabletop across the lower quarter, warm ivory side light, clean upper left negative space, subtle gold veining on the stone, only the empty wall and stone surface.
